thread:
opsbot: ALERT: Multiple control-plane heartbeats missed in eu-ireland (eire1). High 5xx rate from edge -> origin.

maya.chen: seeing spike in 5xxs and API latency from eire1, dashboards show control-plane silence.

tom.kapoor: confirmed — kube-apiserver not answering, node heartbeats missing across several AZs.

jin_park: running quick probe: `curl -v https://api.eire1.redwood.internal/health` -> connection timeout, no TLS handshake.

lucas: checking provider status — I see a network fabric incident flagged for IRE region: https://status.cloudprov.example/IRE (provider page says routing degradation).

anjali: starting traffic-shift playbook. Plan A: shift inference traffic to eu-frankfurt (FRK) with sfo as backup. Will throttle background jobs first.

tom.kapoor: agree. throttle non-critical provisioning and preemptible jobs. Keep reserved capacity for SLA customers.

maya.chen: triggering emergency failover runbook `/playbooks/failover-region` -> running step 1: remove eire1 from HA proxy pools and update DNS weights.

lucas: announcing withdraw at BGP edge now to stop new sessions heading to eire1.

jin_park: note: KV cache for in-flight sessions will be lost — switch affected routes to stateless fallback to avoid session-corruption. Avoid global cache warm-up until new nodes stabilize.

anjali: ops action: set ingress QPS limit to 20 rps per API key for FRK, enable prefix cache warmer on a small canary pool.

oncall-rotation: can someone reserve dedicated capacity in FRK and SFO? We need extra GPUs to absorb shifted load — I'll open a procurement ticket.

tom.kapoor: I can spin up 120 GPUs in SFO reserved spot pool, but cost hit will be significant — estimating ~+$12k/day at current rates. Confirm?

maya.chen: confirm — prioritize customer SLAs; non-essential batch workloads must be paused. CS: prepare tenant impact list for those pinned to eire1.

lucas: creating incident bridge and will post link. Bridge: https://meet.example/incident-3098765432

opsbot: Incident created: INC-2026-3098765432 severity=P0 assigned=oncall-rotation started_at=2026-03-20T12:00:32Z

jin_park: quick log dump snippet:
```
$ kubectl get nodes --all-namespaces -o wide
NAME              STATUS     AGE
node-a            NotReady   1h
node-b            NotReady   58m
control-plane     Unknown    5m
```

anjali: immediate next actions (owner): 1) Engage provider support (ticket #123456) [lucas], 2) Shift traffic and update routing [maya/tom], 3) Reserve GPUs and start minimal proxies [tom], 4) Update status page & CS comms [maya/cs-team].

maya.chen: drafting status page: "We are experiencing a complete outage in eu-ireland; traffic is being shifted to eu-frankfurt and sfo. Customers may see degraded latency. Initial ETA ~2 hours for mitigation." Will post after quick review.

tom.kapoor: starting capacity spin-up now. ETA first machines ~18 minutes.

oncall-rotation: ack — please provide timeline updates every 15m. Paging @cs-team for customer comms.

cs-team: received — we'll prepare templated messages (status page, in-product banner, direct emails for impacted enterprise customers).

lucas: provider responded in ticket: "Investigating router-level forwarding issue, no ETA yet." Ticket updated.

opsbot: Update: autoscaling in eire1 suppressed due to control-plane silence — switching to emergency manual scale in FRK/SFO.

jin_park: holding cache warmer to avoid thundering herd once new capacity is up; will coordinate warmers to ramp slowly.

maya.chen: documenting actions in incident doc: /incidents/3098765432-eu-ireland-failover.md (adding owners and timeline).

tom.kapoor: first 32 GPUs are up in SFO and proxy test traffic is flowing; initial smoke tests look okay.

maya.chen: monitoring - FRK handling proxied control-plane API but latency +25% and some model inference tails increased. Continuing to monitor error rate.

oncall-rotation: keep updating the bridge every 15m. If provider gives ETA we re-evaluate rollback to normal routing.

cs-team: standing by to escalate customer outages and coordinate bill-of-materials for credits if SLA breached.

lucas: provider just updated ticket: "Root cause appears to be an underlay routing flap; working with on-call infra at provider." No ETA still.

opsbot: Incident status: mitigation in progress — traffic shifted, extra capacity provisioning underway, communication draft prepared. Next update in 15 minutes.
